svg.title: About Montaser
svg.desc: Hi, I'm Montaser. I'm a Cybersecurity and Software Engineering student with a strong passion for building and understanding low level systems. Currently studying at 42 and ASU, my technical focus spans C/C++ systems programming, UNIX environments, digital forensics, and secure infrastructure. I enjoy breaking down complex problems, whether that means tackling CTF challenges or analyzing data. Outside the terminal, I stay creative by playing guitar, designing pixel art, and helping lead the GDGoC tech community.
